title: Fused sparse addressing, structural admission, predictive transition routing, and verified operator consolidation
question: Can the validated product-key addressing frontier and the PST-StructMeans-AXON-REGM-SECA loop be composed so that final decision work is fixed as M grows while preserving held-out operator capability?
hypothesis: A structural middle index and predictive transition scorer should improve target admission and selection at fixed absolute routing budgets, while verified experience should support PST reconstruction, AXON reuse, and independently verified SECA composition.

arms.name: pkm
arms.intervention: product-key addressing followed by a fixed absolute final shortlist

arms.name: structmeans
arms.intervention: product-key addressing followed by StructMeans structural admission and a fixed absolute shortlist

arms.name: pst
arms.intervention: product-key addressing followed by StructMeans admission and PST transition reranking

endpoints.name: top1_success
endpoints.description: held-out single-step target selection success under the registered absolute final budget

decision_rule.condition: Compare pkm, structmeans, and pst at every registered M and absolute budget; report top1_success and all routing-cost diagnostics without selecting an outcome-dependent winner.
decision_rule.licenses: a workload-specific comparison of the fused routing interventions.
decision_rule.does_not_license: universal routing improvement, hardware speedup, or asymptotic sublinear addressing.

decision_rule.condition: If pst_reconstruction_accuracy_heldout_signature and axon_bound_reuse_accuracy meet their independently verified thresholds, the corresponding consolidation mechanisms are supported on this synthetic operator family.
decision_rule.licenses: support for verified transition reconstruction and bound operator reuse on this workload.
decision_rule.does_not_license: broad-domain continual learning or universal reasoning.

decision_rule.condition: post_seca_success is evaluated only on tasks for which single-step retrieval did not already solve the composite target.
decision_rule.licenses: evidence that verified composition can create executable composite operators on the registered workload.
decision_rule.does_not_license: that SECA repairs poor base retrieval.

held_constant: three operator kinds: toggle, set1, set0
training uses verified transitions only for PST/StructMeans
held-out operator signatures are excluded from the structural training set
SECA is not used to alter single-step routing metrics
product-key internal exact address scoring is reported separately from final absolute budget
